semiconductor_relevance: High — JST Manufacturing provides specialized equipment crucial for semiconductor wafer fabrication processes.
summary: JST Manufacturing designs and manufactures custom wet benches for the semiconductor industry, focusing on wafer surface preparation and equipment retrofitting. Their solutions aim to enhance ROI, reduce cleanroom footprints, and increase throughput, with a strong emphasis on innovation and cost-effectiveness.
capabilities: Custom wet benches for semiconductor manufacturing
Retrofitting services for existing semiconductor equipment
Large fab parts restoration to a particle-free state

regional_presence.United States: JST Manufacturing operates a vertically integrated manufacturing facility in Meridian, Idaho, dedicated to semiconductor equipment innovation.
